summary.en: Kedrion's disclosed development focuses on plasma-derived products and rare diseases, including immunoglobulin expansions and plasminogen eye drops. Public asset-level information is limited.
summary.zh: Kedrion披露的研发聚焦血浆源产品和罕见病,包括免疫球蛋白适应症拓展和纤溶酶原滴眼液。公开的资产层面信息有限。

ind.en: Pediatric primary immunodeficiency; also stiff person syndrome
ind.zh: 儿童原发性免疫缺陷;另有僵人综合征

ind.en: Ligneous conjunctivitis in type 1 plasminogen deficiency
ind.zh: 1型纤溶酶原缺乏症的木样结膜炎

watch.en: QIVIGY received FDA orphan designation for stiff person syndrome in September 2026; a clinical study is underway.
watch.zh: QIVIGY于2026年9月获FDA僵人综合征孤儿药资格认定;临床研究正在进行。

watch.en: Factor V received EMA orphan designation; that does not establish approval or a clinical phase.
watch.zh: 因子V获EMA孤儿药资格认定;这并不表明已获批或处于某一临床阶段。

watch.en: R&D includes extremely rare diseases and improvements to plasma-derived products and manufacturing.
watch.zh: 研发包括极罕见疾病以及对血浆源产品和生产工艺的改进。

sources: 2024 sustainability report, published July 2025: internal plasminogen and Factor V development
gaps: No published numerical phase totals or dated 2026 quarterly/half-year financial report were verified; only three disclosed development assets are included.
Current clinical phases for Factor V and plasminogen eye drops were not verified. The 2024 sustainability report describes Factor V as preclinical; no later clinical transition was established.
IVIg uses the pediatric Phase 3 programme; the SPS clinical phase was not established. IVIg discovery provenance and a specific molecular target remain unverified.
No dated future milestones were verified for the selected programmes.
The pediatric registry update and Factor V release date from May 2026, before June 2026; the R&D page is undated. Internal provenance uses the 2024 sustainability report published in July 2025.
